verdicts.reason: Both just shrink the landscape design into the portrait canvas, leaving big empty white bands above and below. The background pattern isn't extended and nothing is rearranged for the taller format. A also enlarges the white frame until it almost touches the left and right canvas edges, so the frame's margins drift from the original. B keeps the original inset frame and card proportions more faithfully, so it is marginally the better of two clearly unfinished resizes.
